answer: Trust propagates through bounded random walks on an attestation trellis, so votes reflect weighted reachability, not raw identities. A Sybil cluster may echo internally, but a sparse external cut gives it low conductance: few walks enter from honest seeds. With capped per-node influence, this bottleneck limits the cluster’s aggregate voting weight to its seed-connected flow, preventing a fabricated plume of identities from gaining proportional power.
